CRM and discount correlation
JD10Welcome is issued by the welcome journey, 10OFF by abandonment recovery. These charts test how closely each code tracks the CRM activity that issues it.
Welcome journey: sign-ups, welcome clicks and JD10Welcome redemption, each indexed to its own peak
Abandonment journey: sends, clicks and 10OFF redemption, each indexed to its own peak
